chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Abu al-Bakhtari, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said:
Whoever wears a yellow sandal will be in delight until he wears it out.

key_terms.يُبْلِيَهَا: He wears it out / destroys it

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling or virtue of wearing yellow sandals according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the subtle psychological impact of color on human emotion, specifically noting that yellow footwear induces a state of joy or delight as long as it remains intact. In Shia scholarly tradition, this reflects the broader principle of *adab* (etiquette) in daily life, where aesthetic choices are seen as influencing spiritual and emotional states, encouraging believers to cultivate positive dispositions through their outward appearance.
